objectives of the Institution.
(10)  To  participate  in  Dispute  Resolution,  Arbitration,
and Expert Witness Sevices on matters related to Building
Services.
(11)  To  use  the  funds,  resources  and  properties  of  the
Institution solely for the official purposes of the Institution.
(12) To admit, reprimand, suspend, institute disciplinary
action, disenroll, and accept the resignation of, any applicant
or member and attend to all matters related to the membership
of the Institution.
